title: RequestDecisionReport
description: HTTP 200 response body of POST /api/v1/verify-request. Derived from src/policy_verifier/models.py::RequestDecisionReport and the decision logic in src/policy_verifier/verifier.py::PolicyVerificationEngine.check_request. Error responses (HTTP 422) are documented in README.md, not here. Additional properties are allowed so that new optional fields can be added without breaking consumers.

decision.description: Outcome of the request check. ALLOWED: the request is entailed by the policies and role assignment. DENIED: the negation of the request is entailed. NOT_DETERMINED: the policies do not decide the request; reason_code says why.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason. Fixed pairing with decision: ALLOWED -> request_entailed; DENIED -> request_prohibited; NOT_DETERMINED -> policy_set_contradictory, solver_unknown or not_covered_by_policies.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of the decision. Wording may change; consumers must branch on decision and reason_code, not on this text.

consistency_query.description: Z3 check of the policies plus the request role facts alone. unsat means the policy set is contradictory for this subject.

allow_query.description: Z3 check of the policies, role facts and the NEGATED request. unsat means the request is entailed (ALLOWED).

deny_query.description: Z3 check of the policies, role facts and the request. unsat means the request is prohibited (DENIED).

constraints.description: The formal constraints that were encoded: one rule per policy, one fact per known role, the query and its negation.

assumptions.description: Modelling assumptions in force, as human-readable strings (the model field is list[str], not an object). The role-witness axiom is enabled by default; the role-exclusivity axiom is always disabled for request checking because the request roles are encoded as a complete role assignment.

enum: Role-exclusivity axiom disabled for independent request checking.

execution_time_ms.description: Wall-clock time spent in check_request, in milliseconds.

limitations.description: Known scope limitations of the decision, as human-readable strings.

status.description: Raw Z3 result for this query (lower case, as returned by Z3).

reason_unknown.description: Z3's reason when status is unknown; null otherwise.

expression.description: Readable first-order-logic rendering, e.g. "∀x (Administrators(x) → CanDelete(x, UserAccounts))".
